NONE: › your idea or opinion of yourself, especially your feeling of your own importance and ability
自我評價；自我中心；自負；自尊心
› specialized psychology in psychoanalysis, the part of a person's mind that tries to match the hidden desires (= wishes) of the id (= part of the unconscious mind) with the demands of the real world
（心理分析上的）自我

example: That man has such an enormous ego - I've never known anyone so full of themselves!
那個人自負得要命——我從來沒有見過這麽自以為是的人。
I'm glad she got the job - she needed something to boost/bolster her ego (= give her confidence).
我很高興她得到了這份工作——她太需要點甚麼來增強她的信心了。

NONE: › something that you do because it makes you feel important and also shows other people how important you are
自我表現；自吹自擂；出風頭

example: He was on another one of his ego trips, directing and taking the main part in a movie.
他又在大出風頭了，親自出馬執導影片，並在其中扮演主要角色。

NONE: › thinking only about yourself and what is good for you
自我中心的；自私自利的

example: Babies are entirely egocentric, concerned only with when they will next be fed.
嬰兒都是完全以自我爲中心的，他們只關心下次甚麽時候餵他們。

egotist
egotistic

自大狂；極端自我主義

自大狂，極端自我主義者

› thinking only about yourself and considering yourself better and more important than other people

年僅18歲就聞名世界只是讓這位女演員變得更加自負。
